newsitem.title: USA: Sacramento, Calif., sells $205 mln TRANs.
newsitem.headline: Sacramento, Calif., sells $205 mln TRANs.

text.p: Two firms won portions of a $205 million Sacramento, Calif., Tax and Revenue Anticipation Note offering.
BancAmerica won $100 million of the notes with a 4.50 percent coupon and a 3.9668 percent net interest cost (NIC) and $55 million of the notes with a 4.50 percent coupon and 3.9957 percent NIC.
BT Securitirs won $50 million of the notes with a 4.50 percent coupon and 3.979 percent NIC. --U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
